summary.summary: On 2026-01-20 at 11:31 UTC the auth-service generated a HIGH‑severity credential‑stuffing alert. In a one‑hour window 32 distinct usernames failed login attempts from 27 different sources, far exceeding the learned baseline of ~0.8 failures (z‑score 31.2). This represents a massive spike compared with normal login failure rates.
summary.likely_trigger: A credential‑stuffing attack (ATT&CK T1110.004) targeting the auth-service, likely using automated bots to try many username/password combos.
summary.suggested_next_check: Examine the auth-service logs for the offending source IPs and usernames, and verify that rate‑limiting or account lockout controls are active and effective.
